text:
anika: Heads-up — the prod inference-p95 alert has been firing ~every 5m since ~03:10 UTC. Mostly short spikes during the canary rollout. Anyone know which dashboard panel shows p95 by replica? Can we mute the pager while rollout stabilizes?

ton y: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/model-serving-dashboard/p95-overview?orgId=1 — check panel 'p95 by replica'. If it is rollout noise we can do a short mute or temporarily bump threshold.

sara: waving hi — this is the canary2 wave, autoscaler is killing/recreating a few pods which causes short latency blips. I think a short mute is fine, don't want to hide an actual outage though.

liam: Quick operational option: create a 30m mute in Alertmanager for the specific alert label (env=prod, alertname=InferenceP95High). Example command: `kubectl -n monitoring exec -it deploy/alertmanager -- amtool silence add matchers alertname=InferenceP95High,env=prod --duration=30m --comment="canary rollout noise"`

anika: thanks — can we also adjust the rule window? It's firing on 1m -> maybe increase evaluation window?

tony: I wouldn't extend the for: too much (that delays real detection). Prefer: short mute + investigate root cause. If this pattern repeats during autoscaler churn we can add a label whitelist or tweak threshold from 700ms -> 1s for a limited time.

sara: I'll pause the canary bump for 20m and watch. If liam applies a 30m mute, please ping here when done.

liam: applied the silence and added a comment. devops-bot should confirm.

devops-bot: Alertmanager: silence created (id=7f3c9) for matchers alertname=InferenceP95High,env=prod by liam, duration=30m — https://alertmanager.redwood.net/silences/7f3c9 :white_check_mark:

anika: great, thanks. As a follow-up, where do I grab per-request traces to confirm spikes correspond to transient GC or batching?

tony: Traces: https://tempo.redwood.net/trace?service=model-serving&from=now-1h — filter span=forward_request. Logs: Loki stream https://loki.redwood.net/explore?query=%7Bjob%3D%22model-serving%22%7D.

liam: For the record, here's the alert rule we triggered on (so we can discuss longer-term tuning):

```yaml
- alert: InferenceP95High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"model-serving\",handler!~\"/health.*\"}[2m])) by (le, instance)) > 0.7
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
    env: prod
  annotations:
    summary: \"model-serving p95 > 700ms (prod)\"
    runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Model+Serving+Runbook
```

tony: Long-term options: add a per-replica smoothing, use a longer bucket (rate over 5m) or detect deploy signals and suppress only during rollout windows. We'll draft a proposal after we see whether this pattern repeats.

sara: :thumbsup: monitoring me for 20m, will report back if it reoccurs.

anika: thanks all — closing once silence expires and no new alerts. I'll post quick notes in the postmortem channel if it keeps happening.
